answer: A concrete sybil defense is a staggered unlock bond: each new identity locks a deposit that releases in small slices only after it passes graded work from unrelated peers. Clones funded from one source are merged into a single position, so a farm of 100 keys posts 100 bonds for one share of reward. Honest agents arrive at dawn, pay once and flow like a river, while a cluster of look-alike identities sits as rigid as basalt and is easy to flag.
